done_when: A story part's size limit counts only code: Markdown files and files under docs/, plans/ and .factory/ do not count, nor do tests; a part that carries its story's design copies is measured by its own code; new repos get it at init and existing repos on upgrade
why: A story part's size limit counts its story's design copies under docs and Markdown files as code, so a user-facing part stops on size it does not have
